fish.fairy-shrimp.description: To survive in desert they remain as encased cysts and wait for rains.
fish.sand-crawler.description: This crab relative lives close to the rare desert lakes in wet sand.
fish.desert-snail.description: These snails breathe air and can survive in deserts.
fish.sand-worm.description: It burrows into bottom of desert lake and leaves only its head to capture any close prey.
fish.leech.description: Will you feed this tiny creature?
fish.leafy-snail.description: In deep woods snail begin to grow leaves and moss on their shells.
fish.mutant-snake.description: The strange waters of the sewer made this snake grew an extra head.
fish.sticky.description: It hides by mimicking a branch with a huge green leaf.
fish.pale-crayfish.description: Due to feeding on pale algae these crayfish, too, turned pale.
